Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
Thanks for the last set of my books, and for the Kingsley’s whereof we have been going through a course.[^1]
If I might have the payment for the first edition of [Beechcroft at Rockstone](../books.html#201) I should be glad.
I suppose the [last volume of Cameos](../books.html#213) is waiting for its index, but I hope it will be out before the season is over.[^2]
[The Reputed Changeling ](../books.html#205)is a much better thing I hope than the Rockstone story, which is really only a continuation for the sake of old friends
I suppose it will soon be ready.

Please let these copies be sent, and the sheets to [Tauchnitz](../persons.html#2124).
I hear that [the Dove in the Eagle’s Nest](../books.html#62) is much used as a class book in Switzerland

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Macmillan published a new edition of the complete works of [Charles Kingsley](../persons.html#816) in 1889.

[^2]: Annotated \'yes\'.
